prompt:

| Return 3m            | +5.7% |
| Return 1m            | +5.0% |
| Return 1w            | +0.2% |
| Range position (63d) | 56% |
| 21d realized vol     | 15% |
| Last close           | 64.24 |

DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:

DECISION: HOLD
